description: Given the author names from a page of posts, say which of them this user already knows. Ask in one call with every name, not one at a time. Each answer carries `standing`: 'dormant' means they know them and the correspondence stopped, which is the strongest reason to appear under a post; 'known' means they are still in touch; 'stranger' means they are not connected. Rank dormant first, known second, and keep a stranger only when the subject is squarely the user's own. `last_spoke` and `messages_exchanged` are there so you can say why this person is worth the reply.

names.description: Author names exactly as the post search gave them.

name: match_my_network
title: Who do I know here
